title.narrative: Prevention of Malaria through Vector Control (PMVC)

description.narrative: Under the PMVC contract, Abt and its partners will work with country governments to integrate indoor residual spray campaigns with distribution of insecticide treated nets--two proven, life-saving malaria vector control interventionsas well as new tools adopted by PMI such as larval source management.
